messages.author: b7bcce299897df4a
messages.subject: command gl2fasta
parts:
Hi,
I have a genlight file, named tr4.o :
> tr4.o
 /// GENLIGHT OBJECT /////////

 // 9 genotypes,  580 binary SNPs, size: 13.2 Mb
 75 (1.44 %) missing data

 // Basic content
   @gen: list of 9 SNPbin
   @ploidy: ploidy of each individual  (range: 2-2)

 // Optional content
   @ind.names:  9 individual labels
   @loc.names:  580 locus labels
   @loc.all:  580 alleles
   @position: integer storing positions of the SNPs
   @pop: population of each individual (group size range: 1-1)
   @strata: a data frame with 5 columns ( id, pop, genotype, country, clade_lineage )
   @other: a list containing: loc.all.misformed  loc.metrics  ind.metrics  history

I then used the gl2fasta command to export it as fasta:

gl2fasta(tr4.o,outfile="tr4.outgroups_SNPs.fas",method=2,outpath="~PROJETS/beta1"), and the output file contains 30383 positions. Can you explain ?
Thanks in advance,
Best wishes,
Emmanuel

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: command gl2fasta
parts:
Hi Emmanuel,

Not sure what the issue is there. You have 580 loci ranging from 20 to 69 bp if your data was produced by DArT (use gl.report.taglength to see distribution -- see attached report for the testset.gl), so you would expect approximately 580x69 bases in each record in your fastA file. That comes to 40020.

You have only 30,380 presumably because not all sequence tags in your dataset were 69 bp long, and because the script takes out sequence tags that have been over-trimmed in removing the adaptors (taking the SNP position with the adaptor -- happens infrequently when the adaptor sequence and the terminal end of the sequence tag are fairly similar by chance).

To check this out, you could remove all loci for which the sequence tag is less than 69

gl2 <- gl.filter.taglength(tr4.o,lower=69)

then

gl2fasta(gl2,outfile="tr4.outgroups_SNPs.fas",method=2,outpath="~PROJETS/beta1")

And you should have around 30,380, the remaining distortion owing to the removal of the few sequence tags where the SNP was removed when the tag was trimmed of adaptors.

Can you give this a try?

A

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: command gl2fasta
parts:
Hi Emanuel,

We are struggling to get the beta version of dartR up to a standard where we can put it up on CRAN. Too many inconsistencies remain, with people like you helping immensely in bringing matters to our attention.

The version I am using is dartR 1.5.5.

This can be installed with

install.packages("leaflet.providers")
install.packages("lifecycle")
install.packages("farver")
install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR", ref="dev") # no need to upgrade prior installs, answer no.

Also to be safe run

gl <- gl.compliance.check(gl)

This will have the two tag length scripts in it. Can you please use this.

I have appended the two tag length scripts just in case.

A
